name: Student Center East

origin.description: Main entrance doors (survey export CSE-20260926-1530, averaged GPS), x east, y north

nodes.name: Main entrance
nodes.notes: Survey export CSE-20260926-1530 obs #3 ('Door 1'), GPS 3 m (11 samples). The STUDENT CENTER EAST doors: a glass vestibule with two sets of double doors. headingDeg 307.8 = facing out as recorded (spread 57 deg, the owner turned round); the walk in (123.2 deg, spread 7) gives 303. The only entrance surveyed. Access (owner, 2026-09-26): public Mon-Thu 08:00-22:00 and Fri 08:00-20:00 (weekday hours from engagement.gsu.edu); PantherCard-only at every other time, all weekend included.

nodes.name: the main lobby
nodes.notes: Survey obs #5 ('Speaker's Auditorium Lobby'): the lobby by the elevators, information desk and the September Movies poster. Walk #4 from the door: 7 steps = 5.38 m at 150.4 deg. Its +-42 deg wander is the owner turning round after the facing-out reading plus the start of the right turn here; the video shows one turn only, at this spot (about 150 to 230 deg).

nodes.name: Speaker Auditorium
nodes.notes: Survey obs #7 ('Speaker's Auditorium', doorSide RIGHT). No room number seen. The SPEAKER'S AUDITORIUM lettering is on the end wall ahead; the double doors are in the recess on the right of that wall (video, last seconds), so doorFacing southeast makes the arrival read 'on your right'. Walk #6: 14 steps = 10.76 m at 230.5 deg (GPS says 5 m, indoor fix 7 m: steps win).

edges.hint: through both sets of glass doors

anchors.description: SPEAKER'S AUDITORIUM lettering on the end wall, doors on its right
anchors.notes: Survey obs #8, facingDeg 46.5 from the straight-on shot, widthCm 500 (estimated, not taped), centre 250 cm, offset 0 (at the room node; the wall is a few metres further). Thin light letters on a plain wall: OCR reads 'SPEA ER'S AUDITC RIUM' at 136 px per character. Photo anchors/CSE/CSE-A01.jpg is the straight shot (hint only; arcoreimg 0).

anchors.description: SEPTEMBER MOVIES @ CINEFEST poster tower in the main lobby, facing the entrance
anchors.notes: Survey obs #9, facingDeg 332.2, widthCm 50 (estimated), recorded height 50 cm (the tower stands on the floor and is about 2 m tall, so heightM 1.0 = estimated centre), offset 0.5 m from the lobby node. Image = straight shot, tower plus a margin of lobby, greyscale equalised, 860x1600, arcoreimg 80; the tower is about 420 of 860 px, so widthM = 0.5 x 860/420 = 1.02. Temporary poster (films to Sept 30): check it is still there before the demo.

startPoints.name: Passio Go stop
startPoints.notes: Survey START obs #1 ('Passio Go'), GPS 3 m (10 samples). Walk #2 to the door: 9 steps = 6.9 m at 123 deg (GPS gives 3.5 m).
